notes.title: 1.01 Patch Notes + Japanese Localization
notes.content:
We've updated Love is in the Airship. There is now a Japanese localization available, plus some minor updates in advance of the bigger content update coming soon.


 Added Language Switch. Switch in the settings menu or the main menu!
 Language should automatically be set based on your system language,
 Added Japanese language,
 Updated credits,
 When clicking on Auto-Foward button, a message on the top left will display telling you it has been toggled.,
 Skip Unread Text is now turned off by default,
 Adjusted skip button to be gray when you are unable to skip.,
 Fixed typo in Intro ("theirchance to get onto the Tibarn."),
 Fixed typo in Bar visit 1 ("dreamsare"),
 Fixed window graphic not appearing when inputting name,
 Fixed bug where player name will not be renamed to "You" if you make your name blank,
 Fixed "Triangle" achievement not triggering if you do the "Horns and Umbrellas" route,
 In the demo, fixed bug where it would lead to "Do something" action which wasn't supposed to be there

notes.title: Yuri Kissaten Espresso - 5 New Game Trailers!
notes.content:
In advance of the Game Pavilion event in Osaka on March 29th, we’re showing off 5 new game trailers with our first-ever Yuri Kissaten Espresso!

(You can also read this post on our site.)


As we announced before with our 5 for ’25 Campaign, Yuri Kissaten is working on many different projects this year. We’re doing our absolute best to create a diverse slate of lesbian-centric narrative games that move and entertain. It’s a ridiculous notion to stake ourselves on a brand-new indie game studio in 2025, but we’re doing it anyway.

Our first Yuri Kissaten Espresso video shows off 5 new game trailers–and 2 of them are brand-new game announcements!

notes.title: Yuri Kissaten Patreon Launch
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45162870/fe332dbca4c9bcae19a412b68bb8d1e92313a479.png
Hey y'all! It's been over four months since Love is in the Airship released, and we'll be giving you the heads up on Yuri Kissaten's plans for 2025. They are wildly ambitious, way too busy, and something you ought to follow as closely as you can.

First things first, I'd like to tell you that we're preparing the first big Love is in the Airship content update. Y'all said the best thing about this game is the hidden depth and myriad of secret story paths, so we're planning on delivering you even more things to discover. New scenes, new endings, new art, and most importantly... A new romanceable character path! We have a few new romance paths in the works, but the first one will be included in this upcoming update.

You'll be very excited about who we chose... Trust me. Leave your guesses in the comments below so we can see how accurate you were.

With added complexity means a lot of inevitable bugs, though. With time for testing and implementation, the new content update should be out probably in mid-May. But don't be shocked if it comes out a little late, or even a little early. 

There's also a Japanese translation in the works. I guess not many reading this will be super enthused about that, but people at the upcoming Game Pavilion event in Osaka sure will be.

And then, for the main announcement:

Yuri Kissaten has a Patreon!

We launched a Patreon a couple weeks ago, and it's going very strong. Our theme for this year is the 5 for '25 Campaign--we're developing five brand-new full-fledged games in 2025, and trying to complete most of them.

It's obviously going to be a big challenge. Our games work off very small budgets with only a couple of developers each, which means we have to be efficient and creative as possible to make quality video games in a short timespan. And working on several titles at once? You'd think we're nuts. We're not--we're just extremely energized to deliver you some giga-good games.

You can support us on Patreon by becoming a free or paid subscriber. Free subscribers can read monthly updates on what we're up to across our 5 for '25 Campaign, and paid subscribers get access to bonus updates with extra-early sneak peaks at our games, as well as candid, honest posts about our path to becoming a real-deal full-time game development studio. You'll also get early builds of some titles!

2025 is going to be an incredible year for Yuri Kissaten, and we're happy to have you along.

And if you're a Love is in the Airship fan, just know we have a whole lot more where that came from.
